US/Eastern = UTC-5 (assumed standard time unless DST specified, but year 1029 predates DST, so use standard).  
US/Mountain = UTC-7.  
Target time = 02:00 + (-7 - (-5)) = 02:00 + (-2) = 00:00.  
Date: August 6, 1029 (no day change because subtracting 2 hours from 02:00 goes to 00:00 same day).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 00:00
